en: Played for the dead. A win brings home the Oruvel Float; win or lose, Oruvel goes home after.

A side-band worked with brass thread, the kind the river sides wear for luck and a surer hold.
Cloth dyed in kelp until it smells of the deep. Divers swear it keeps their breath long.
A light cork float for drills. A side that trains with it throws farther and reaches sooner.
A float with lead sewn into its seam. Drilling with it makes every stroke count for more.
